name: sous-chef
description: Sous chef: memory and session manager for Claude Code sessions.

scripts.//build: Compile TypeScript from src/ into dist/, then write dist/.build-stamp (scripts/build-stamp.js), which exists only after a complete build. bin/sc refuses to run a missing or stale build (docs/decisions/0023).
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-stamp.js
scripts.//typecheck: Type-check src/ and tests/ without writing output.
scripts.//lint: ESLint over the given files, or the whole repo with no arguments.
scripts.//test: Build, then the TypeScript unit tests (vitest), then the behaviour suite (Python, until it is ported to vitest).
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
